fusions.name: Mossback Maul
fusions.desc: A mauling blow that deals 16 blunt damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds, and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Diseased] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Back to the Wall
fusions.desc: A swipe through a cone 2.5 tiles deep that deals 4 slashing damage to everything in it, 8% more for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40% more. Each hit has a 20% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Den Torpor
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health and reduces the damage you take by 20% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: First Thaw
fusions.desc: When you regain health, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
